literal_meaning: হিকাপ কাটা (হিচকি কাটা বা চুকলি কাটা)
figurative_meaning_en: To criticize or speak ill of someone behind their back
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় অন্যের পিছনে চুকলি কাটে।
example_sentences_in_english: He always cuts hiccups behind others' backs.
The friends were cutting hiccups about him when he wasn't around.
